tools.name: get-actor-run
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific Actor run.

Returns run result: status, storages (datasets/keyValueStores alias map), stats, summary, nextStep.
- summary describes the past (e.g. "SUCCEEDED in 22s. 47 items; 3 fields available.").
- nextStep prescribes one primary follow-up action with ide

tools.name: get-dataset-items
tools.description:
Get items (rows) from a dataset — the output/results produced by an Actor run.
Returns the rows themselves, not dataset metadata, counts, or a schema.
When the user provides a datasetId and asks to retrieve results, output, data, or rows, call this tool directly.
Default limit is 20. Use clean=true

tools.name: get-key-value-store-record
tools.description:
Get the value stored under a specific key in a key-value store — a single record, not a listing of all keys.
Requires the exact key name.
The response preserves the original Content-Encoding; most clients handle decompression automatically.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-dataset-items, gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed, gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor, gouda_studios--youtube-transcript-extractor · Private data: get-key-value-store-record, gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed, gouda_studios--sec-edgar-filings-feed, gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor · Public sink: gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor · Destructive: get-actor-run, get-dataset-items, abort-actor-run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-dataset-items, gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed, gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor, gouda_studios--youtube-transcript-extractor · Private data: get-key-value-store-record, gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed, gouda_studios--sec-edgar-filings-feed, gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor · Public sink: gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor · Destructive: get-actor-run, get-dataset-items, abort-actor-run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
